segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the ticket number if you have one?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Ben at Lakeside Freight. Ticket is 184327. We caught it this morning when three new hires couldn't sign in; the admin console still showed provisioning as successful, so I don't think your side flagged it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it, thanks. I have the ticket open. I see the users are Nora Patel, Chris Wynn, and Mateo Ruiz, all added yesterday around 4:40 p.m. Central. Are they getting the standard login page or an error after SSO?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: After SSO. It says their account isn't active. Everyone else in the Operations group is fine.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay. I'm checking the admin console and the provisioning log now. Their accounts were created, but the active status didn't carry over from the directory group. I'm going to run a resync for just those three users first.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's fine. We need them in before the 2 p.m. training, so as long as it's not a full directory sync.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No, this is targeted. It should take under two minutes. Okay, I see all three changed to active. Can you have one of them try again in a fresh browser window?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: One sec. Yeah, Nora just got in. Chris too. Waiting on Mateo. Okay, he's in now.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Great. I added the notes to ticket 184327 and I'll leave it open until end of day in case any other users from that batch have the same issue.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. If anything else comes up I'll reply on the ticket. Thanks.
